questions.question: Does the vendor enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administrative access to production systems?
Are strong password policies (complexity, minimum length, rotation, reuse) enforced for user accounts?
Are user access reviews performed on a defined cadence (e.g., quarterly)?
Is access provisioning and deprovisioning tied to the HR onboarding and offboarding process?
Is role-based access control (RBAC) and least-privilege enforced across production systems?
Are shared or generic accounts prohibited for production access?
Is privileged access logged, monitored, and reviewed?
Is single sign-on (SSO) via SAML or OIDC used for corporate and SaaS applications?
Is customer data encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent strength?
Is data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher?
Are encryption keys managed in a hardware security module (HSM) or a dedicated key management service (KMS)?
Are encryption keys rotated on a defined schedule?
Is customer data logically or physically segregated between tenants?
Is data classification defined and applied (e.g., public, internal, confidential, restricted)?
Is data retention governed by a documented retention policy?
Are secure data disposal procedures defined for end-of-life storage media?
Does the organization maintain a documented incident response plan?
Is the incident response plan tested at least annually via tabletop exercises or simulations?
What is the customer notification SLA for confirmed security incidents affecting customer data?
Are security incidents logged in a centralized system with defined severity tiers?
Is a 24x7 security operations capability or on-call rotation in place for incident response?
Are post-incident root-cause analyses and forensic procedures documented?
Does the organization maintain a documented business continuity plan (BCP)?
What is the documented recovery time objective (RTO) for tier-1 production systems?
What is the documented recovery point objective (RPO) for tier-1 production systems?
Are disaster recovery (DR) drills performed at least annually with documented results?
Are production backups encrypted and stored in a geographically separate location?
Are authenticated vulnerability scans performed on a regular cadence across production systems?
Does the organization perform third-party penetration testing at least annually?
What is the remediation SLA for critical-severity vulnerabilities in production systems?
Is patch management centralized and tracked against defined SLAs?
Are security findings tracked to closure in a ticketing or GRC system?
Is application security testing (SAST/DAST) integrated into the software development lifecycle?
Has the vendor completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in the last 12 months?
Is the SOC 2 audit scope inclusive of all systems that process or store customer data?
Does the vendor maintain ISO/IEC 27001 certification?
Does the vendor meet PCI DSS, HIPAA, or other applicable regulatory requirements?
Are internal audits conducted on security controls at least annually?
Is there a documented internal control framework aligned to SOC 2 TSC or NIST CSF?
Are audit findings tracked to remediation with management sign-off?
Does the vendor maintain a public list of sub-processors with access to customer data?
Are third-party vendors subject to a formal security risk assessment prior to onboarding?
Is a software bill of materials (SBOM) produced for each production release?
Are third-party code dependencies scanned for known vulnerabilities (e.g., SCA tooling)?
Are contractual protections (e.g., data processing agreements, confidentiality) required for all third parties handling customer data?
Are production systems hosted in data centers with physical security controls certified under SSAE 18 or ISO 27001?
Are production and non-production environments logically or physically segregated?
Is infrastructure-as-code (IaC) used to provision and manage production resources?
Are network segmentation and firewall rules documented, reviewed, and approved?
Are server, container, or VM images hardened per CIS benchmarks or an equivalent standard?
